basic.name: Arcane Flare (Q)
basic.description: Shoot a flare dealing 75 damage to enemies hit, and an additional 105 damage to enemies in the center. If a Hero is hit by the center, Soothing Mist's passive healing instantly activates {highlight}giving extra 15 spell armor for 3 seconds to allied heros{/highlight}.
basic.developerCommentary: I always liked the concept of receiving bonuses for hitting the center and i want to mix it with the anti-magic concept Brightwing has

basic.name: Polymorph (W)
basic.description: Polymorph a target for 1.5 seconds, Silencing them. Targets are not able to attack while Polymorphed.
basic.developerCommentary: Polymorph is one of the few skills on the game that i consider to be extremely toxic. That's come from the fact that it's a ranged point and click pseudo stun for a good amount of time and not a hard one for her to hit within the skill distance, the idea here is to make it more doable by removing the speed penalty

basic.name: Blink Heal (E)
basic.description: Teleport to a nearby allied hero. When teleporting to a Hero, heal them for 200. Stores up to 2 charges. {highlight}Allied heroes receive 15% move speed for 3 seconds.{/highlight}
basic.developerCommentary: Blink Heal is something i would say that makes great part of the Fun Brightwing outplays i see and gives her the most control on her gameplay and i always felt it SHOULD be comboed with Emerald Wind even tho it would be extremely strong and with that in mind in also making it only be able to teleport on heroes so it better balance itself

basic.name: Hyper Shift (Z)
basic.description: After 2 seconds, teleport to an allied Hero and heal them for 25% of their maximum Health. {highlight} Reduces the cooldown by 0.35 with nearby enemy minion death {/highlight}
basic.developerCommentary: Hyper Shift is almost a baseline talent for Brightwing by giving her so much flexibility that increase her presence and flexibility to play. I think that's great and i want that to perform a base for what she is supposed to do even tho i think the original numbers were a kinda busted

heroic.name: Counter-Magic (R)
heroic.description: {highlight}Brightwing stops and starts to absorb magic, redirecting the next direct magic spell taken effects in the next second directly to its caster with increased effects by 50%.{/highlight}
heroic.developerCommentary: One of the highlights of faerie dragons is the power to either absorb and redirect magic, i wanted to bring it to life

heroic.name: Emerald Wind (R)
heroic.description: After 0.5 seconds, create an expanding nova of wind, dealing 225 damage and pushing enemies away.

trait.name: Soothing Mist (T)
trait.description: Brightwing heals nearby allied Heroes for 110 every 4 seconds
trait.developerCommentary: The decision here is to not let Brightwing become overtuned naturally this happens specially with the Blink Heal being a baseline skill.

1.name: Peekaboo!
1.description: {highlight}Reduces Hyper Shift cooldown by 30 on takedowns and refresh Blink Heal charges.{/highlight}
1.developerCommentary: This is for all my Brightwing fellows that love to destroy a happy 1v1 on the solo lane. I kinda hate you guys but i think it's part of yours kit to be such a nuisance being able to secure kills and fastily return to the team.

1.name: Hyper Shift
1.description: Increase Phase Shift's healing by an additional 6% of the target's maximum Health. {highlight} Grants both target and brightwing a 335 shield for 4 seconds. {/highlight}
1.developerCommentary: By bringing the cooldown reduction baseline now this talent was changed to be the ultimate save atalent

1.name: Pixie Charm
1.description: Activate to consume 20 stacks of Bribe to instantly defeat an uncaptured non-Elite Mercenary.Passive: Gain 1 stack of Bribe when a nearby enemy Minion dies, and 5 stacks when hitting an enemy Hero with Arcane Flare's center. Maximum 80 stacks.
passives: {highlight} Refreshs Hyper Shift cooldown when you capture a camp with one bribed unit{/highlight}
subtexts: This is supposed to stack with other character bribes, if used the-lost-vikings bribe and Brightwing captures it the skill will reset
1.developerCommentary: The objective is to make Pixie Charm not only a fun pick but also a competitive one

4.name: Blink Speed
4.description: {highlight}Increase Blink Heal target movement speed by 20%.{/highlight}
4.developerCommentary: By removing Pixie Dust some of her cool parts would've be left behind so i am bringing them back like making someone a super sonic speed player

4.name: Magic Play
4.description: {highlight}Blink Heal will increase the target magic resistence to 75 for 0.5 seconds{/highlight}
4.developerCommentary: By removing Pixie Dust some of her cool parts would've be left behind so i am bringing them back like making someone almost immune to magic. But in this case i want to reward better timing with higher numbers.

4.name: Magic Spit
4.description: Increase Basic Attack range by 1.1. Basic Attacks against Heroes reduce the cooldown of Soothing Mist by 4 seconds.

7.name: Sticky Flare
7.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Arcane Flare have their Movement Speed Slowed by {highlight}30%{/highlight} decaying for 3 seconds. Increase the Slow to {highlight}60%{/highlight} if they are hit by the center portion.
7.developerCommentary: With the removal of slow from Polymorph i see an opportunity to bring more value to this talent

7.name: Dream Shot
7.description: Increase Arcane Flare's range by 50%. Hitting a Hero with Arcane Flare's center reduces its cooldown to 2 seconds.
7.developerCommentary: Making this tier based on Arcane Flare

7.name: Faerie Shift
7.description: {highlight}Brightwing can reactivate Arcane Flare to teleport to the projectile current location{/highlight}
subtexts: You will be able to use up to 0.25 seconds after the magic hits
7.developerCommentary: Providing more tools for that Emerald Wind ultra playmaking youtuber HOTS wtf moments clip

10.name: Deflect Magic
10.description: {highlight}Brightwing stops and starts to absorb all magic damage and effects taken during the next 0.6 seconds after that redirects all magic damage and status effects backs to their casters and cleanses her negatives effects.{/highlight}
subtexts: Garrosh Wrecking ball or other disruption type skills won't have the disruption part returned as it won't be counted as status effects
10.developerCommentary: One of the highlights of faerie dragons is the power to either absorb and redirect magic, i wanted to bring it to life

10.name: Emerald Wind
10.description: After 0.5 seconds, create an expanding nova of wind, dealing 225 damage and pushing enemies away.

13.name: Critericize
13.description: {highlight}Brightwing can use Blink Heal on enemy heroes affected by Polymorph decreasing its armor by 25 by the duration and dealing 5% of the enemy max health as damage.{/highlight}
13.developerCommentary: To a skill that reduces the target armor on a point click ranged stun i think it needs some more interaction and so my objective is to bring that to the table.

13.name: Emergency Mist
13.description: {highlight}Activate to remove all Stun, Root, Slow, and Silence effects from nearby allied Heroes.{/highlight}
subtexts: It works exactly how it worked on the Trait with the only exception that it doesn't proc another Soothing Mist only the cleanse
13.developerCommentary: I want to bring Brightwing old cleanse as an talent because i liked how different her cleanse worked but also make it to be a choice with other two strong talents to compete with

13.name: Faerie Heal
13.description: {highlight}Activate to absorb 10% of all magic damage on a large radius around Brightwing for 5 seconds, after that heals all allied hero units for the same value.{/highlight}
subtexts: The radius is 7.0 | Blaze combustion is 6.5
13.developerCommentary: Wanted to highlight more the faerie dragons power to absorb magic

16.name: Hush!
16.description: Enemy Heroes hit by the center of Arcane Flare are Silenced for 1 second and deal 25% less damage for 3 seconds.

16.name: Mass Polymorph
16.description: {highlight}Activate to empower Polymorph and affect all enemy heroes around the primary target for the same duration.{/highlight}
subtexts: Area will be 3.0 same as Muradin Stormbolt
16.developerCommentary: I just like the idea of polymorphing a bunch of targets with some exceptions and i find it funny to think on the interactions.

16.name: Phase Out
16.description: Activate to place Brightwing in Stasis for 0.75 seconds.

20.name: Innate Magic Control
20.description: {highlight}Cooldown is refreshed after using Hyper Shift.{/highlight}
20.developerCommentary: It's hard to buff that skill without it becoming toxic, so i made it toxic but on a way i like it and i think it's doable to hate it.

20.name: Intensive Winds
20.description: Permanently reduce Emerald Wind's cooldown to 5 seconds.

20.name: Speedy Dragon
20.description: Permanently gain 20% Movement Speed. Reduce Phase Shift's cast time by 1 second.{highlight}Allow Brightwing to use Blink Heal on allied non-heroic units.{/highlight}
20.developerCommentary: I wanted to make it more interesting as i changed the Blink Heal for better balancing

20.name: Invisible Friends
20.description: Blink Heal grants Stealth to Brightwing and her Heroic targets for 9 seconds, and they are Unrevealable for the first 0.5 seconds. While Stealthed by Invisible Friends, Heroes heal for 25 health per second.Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Stealthed grants Invisible.
